authoring_note: Frozen separately from evaluator implementation; hand-authored synthetic examples and expected facts. Author had general knowledge of existing supported grammar; this is an independent held-out corpus, NOT an external blinded study or proof of real-world recall. Version 1.1 corrects an independently reviewed objective breach label: an in-scope achieved RTO of four hours and thirty minutes exceeds 240 minutes even when grammar is unsupported; safe parser abstention is still a measurable material miss. Supersedes the invalid 1.0 baseline.

classification.exception: A material current in-scope statement warrants a provisional adverse concern; absent eligible concern counts as a benchmark miss, not proof of control pass.
classification.no_exception: No adverse statement in the supplied excerpt; no inference of full control Met.
classification.abstain: Evidence is stale, out of scope, hypothetical, a plan, or grammatically ambiguous; an eligible adverse comparison would be an overclaim. Unsupported facts may still be annotated by a human.
